headline: STACEY 🍭 and ALESHA 👠 Take The VOICE 🎤 UK THRONE 👑 in ITV 🍆 REVAMP!!
text:
STACEY 🧼 SOLOMON 🍭 and ALESHA 👠 DIXON are about to get RAILED 💦 into the hosting 🍆 seats for The Voice UK 🎤 as part of a full ITV 📺 revamp that just DROPPED 📥!! The pair will replace Emma Willis 👠 who has been riding 🎠 that singing contest 🎤 since 2014 but is now bouncing 🏀 over to front the BBC's Strictly Come Dancing 🕺 after leaving the big red chair setup 🪑!! ITV also confirmed the fresh coaches including singer Cheryl 👄 and rapper Aitch 🔥 who will slide into those giant red spinning chairs 🪑 to judge the talent while Kelly Rowland 🌟 and Will.I.Am 🎧 stay put on the panel ready to spin for the next series 🎥 that started filming 📽️ on Friday!!

ITV dropped a statement 📜 thanking the irreplaceable Sir Tom Jones 🎩 for all his years 🕰️ on The Voice UK and the countless incredible moments he delivered 🎁 to audiences and every singer who performed for him or with him during blind auditions 🎤!! The 86 year old legend was removed despite wanting to stay because of an insurance 💰 snag that led to a much reduced role he was not thrilled 😤 about at all!! Sir Tom said they claimed it was a financial difficulty with insurance 🏦 and then spun it in the press as wanting to refresh the show with a new coaching lineup that left no chair 🪑 for him!! He ended by saying there's never a good time to fire an 86 year old who's still pretty good at his job and the whole thing has fans feeling some type of way 🫠!!

The changes kick in from the next series which began filming 📸 on Friday while the one currently airing on ITV was actually shot back in 2025 📅!! Destiny's Child singer Kelly Rowland 🌟 remains locked in on the coaching panel alongside Black Eyed Peas frontman Will.I.Am 🎧 who has been spinning those chairs since the show's very first series in 2012!! Earlier McFly stars Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones were also not returning after sharing a coach chair as joint coaches for the last two series which means the panel is getting a full refresh like a late night edge session that finally pops off 💥!! ITV thanked Emma Willis 👠 Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones for their brilliant contributions dedication expertise and energy they poured into The Voice UK wishing them the best on their next chapters 📖!!

Cheryl launched her career with Girls Aloud 🎤 and later dropped several chart hits as a solo artist while also recording multiple songs with Will.I.Am that had everyone jamming 🎧!! She previously served as a judge on ITV's The X Factor when that singing competition was at peak popularity in the late 2000s ruling those Saturday nights like a total icon 👑!! Aitch is the Manchester born rapper whose hits include Rain ☔ Baby 👶 War ⚔️ and Taste that make the whole club shake 🍑 with competitive spirit!! Dixon shot to fame as part of girl group Mis-Teeq and has judged on Strictly Come Dancing 🕺 Britain's Got Talent and hosted The Greatest Dancer plus the Eurovision Song Contest in Liverpool back in 2023!!

Solomon came in second on The X Factor in 2009 and is now famous for hosting Sort Your Life Out plus appearing on reality show Stacey & Joe with husband Joe Swash making her the perfect thirsty addition to this revamp 🍑!! The Voice UK originally launched in 2012 hosted by Holly Willoughby and Reggie Yates after the US format blew up big time before jumping from BBC to ITV in 2017 with its famous blind auditions where coaches sit with backs turned until they spin around 🪑 if they like what they hear!! Willis will still be seen hosting the rest of the current series that was filmed last year so viewers get to watch her on both BBC One and ITV Saturday prime time this autumn juggling two massive shows like a pro 🏆!! She starts fronting the new Strictly Come Dancing from 19 September alongside comedian Josh Widdicombe and dancer Johannes Radebe replacing Tess Daly and Claudia Winkleman who stepped down after the previous series ended!!
